issues.description: The problem statement text (lines describing the task) refers to a method named getTotalStudents(), while the UML diagram, template comments, and the provided solution all use getTotalNumberOfStudents(). This name mismatch in the problem description can confuse students about which method to implement and what the exact signature should be.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the method name across the problem statement, template, and solution. Update the problem statement text to refer to getTotalNumberOfStudents() (matching the UML, template TODO, and solution), or alternatively update UML and solution to use getTotalStudents() if that shorter name is preferred. Ensure all references (task descriptions and tests) use the same name to avoid student confusion.
